raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (ingested 2026-01-17, holding the 2026-01-16 transactions) sent txn_ts as DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS instead of ISO format, so the timestamp cast fails. The day value (16) is greater than 12, which rules out a month-first reading, and the date matches the batch's ingest day, so the values can be parsed safely.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.82, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, COALESCE(try_strptime(txn_ts, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4} ') THEN try_strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') END, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP)) AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s"}}
